name: Kevin Kiley
stance: Bipartisan co-lead on U.S.-China frontier-AI safety coordination and verification.

statements.text: In recent weeks there has been an astonishing acceleration in the capability of leading AI models. As a society, we are not remotely prepared for the implications.
Co-introduced with Rep. Liccardo a bipartisan bill establishing U.S.-China coordination on frontier AI safety — binding standards, model testing, independent auditing and incident reporting.

review.note: added October 2026; record verified via the co-lead's primary release
